query: 重要性（Materiality）评估 重要性（Materiality）评估 衡量企业识别并优先管理重大ESG议题的能力。 2分：采用了双重重要性原则（同时考虑财务影响与对环境/社会的影响）；详细披露了利益相关方参与的具体数据；议题与公司战略、KPI挂钩。 1分：披露了评估流程（如发放调查问卷），并提供了重要性矩阵 (Materiality Matrix)，但缺乏动态调整或双重重要性（Double Materiality）的思考。 0分：未披露重要性评估过程，或仅列出议题清单，未解释议题是如何选出的，无矩阵或排名。 重要性评估 实质性议题 重要性矩阵 双重重要性 利益相关方参与 议题排序 影响重要性 财务重要性 Double Materiality materiality assessment material topics materiality matrix double materiality stakeholder engagement issue prioritization impact materiality financial materiality Double Materiality 重要性评估流程如何开展？ 利益相关方如何参与及是否有具体数据？ 是否提供重要性矩阵或议题排名？ 是否采用双重重要性？ 重大议题是否与战略/KPI挂钩并动态调整？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '重要性（Materiality）评估'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 重要性评估流程如何开展？ 利益相关方如何参与及是否有具体数据？ 是否提供重要性矩阵或议题排名？ 是否采用双重重要性？ 重大议题是否与战略/KPI挂钩并动态调整？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅列出ESG议题清单无筛选过程；仅有社区需求调查；仅有气候风险清单；仅有GRI内容索引无评估方法；区分：重要性评估是公司级ESG议题优先排序；社区参与是社区关系战略；社会影响评估是项目社会后果评估；TCFD是气候披露框架。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: For our inaugural Sustainability Report FY2019, we engaged an independent third-party to facilitate our materiality assessment process using a three-step approach. Since then, we have conducted a review of the identified material matters annually. In FY2021, the Board has assessed that the six material matters reported in FY2020 remain relevant priorities for FY2021. Additionally, the existing topic 'Emissions (Air, Land, Water)' was expanded to also include disclosure on relevant climate-related issues, in line with the Stock Exchange requirements.

results.text: As we continue to roll out new initiatives to reduce the environmental footprint of our products, we recognise that engaging with our suppliers is crucial to meeting our goals. Since FY2020, we have issued formal letters with our Green Product and Process requirements to all our suppliers and requested a yearly report from them on their environmental performance, including their carbon footprint. On an ongoing basis, we also consult with key suppliers and welcome their ideas on how our products and processes can be made more sustainable.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
SUSTAINABILITY IN OUR SUPPLY CHAINS

[Content]
As we continue to roll out new initiatives to reduce the environmental footprint of our products, we recognise that engaging with our suppliers is crucial to meeting our goals. Since FY2020, we have issued formal letters with our Green Product and Process requirements to all our suppliers and requested a yearly report from them on their environmental performance, including their carbon footprint. On an ongoing basis, we also consult with key suppliers and welcome their ideas on how our products and processes can be made more sustainable.
